tests.name: node02_system_python_is_incompatible_negative
tests.expected_reason: node02 /usr/bin/python3 is Python 3.6 and cannot parse the sealed 3.9+ control source

tests.name: renamed_binding_with_original_sidecar_negative
tests.operation: copy xp_successor_binding.json and its sidecar to a different JSON basename without rewriting sidecar content, then invoke verify_xp_binding_basename

tests.name: systemd219_mainpid_property_positive
tests.operation: run systemctl show --property=MainPID UNIT and parse exact output MainPID=46
tests.expected_reason: systemd 219 supports property assignment form without --value

tests.name: systemd_mainpid_ambiguous_or_zero_negative
tests.operation: feed MainPID=0, duplicate MainPID lines, or any extra output to the parser
tests.expected_reason: daemon PID authority must be one exact nonzero MainPID assignment

tests.name: docker_started_at_trailing_zero_same_instant_positive
tests.expected_reason: strict RFC3339 UTC parsing maps both spellings to the same nanosecond integer

tests.name: docker_started_at_one_nanosecond_change_negative
tests.expected_reason: a real one-nanosecond container start-time change remains fail-closed

tests.name: docker_mount_and_io_array_order_positive
tests.operation: feed two otherwise identical selected-field readbacks with reversed mount and blkio array order
tests.expected_reason: canonical stable projection sorts contract rows

tests.name: docker_irrelevant_mount_diagnostic_positive
tests.operation: change an unconsumed Docker mount diagnostic field while keeping Type/Name/Source/Destination/Driver/Mode/RW/Propagation exact

tests.name: docker_real_identity_resource_change_negative
tests.operation: change PID, StartedAt, cpuset, memory, throttle Path/Rate, or a stable mount field between reads
tests.expected_reason: real stable identity/resource change remains fail-closed
